label: e4_b300_sglang
stage: engine comparison (Maks: 'perhaps try sglang instead of vllm?')
note: SGLang v0.5.23 on the B300 (SM103), speculation off, against vLLM 0.34 (s1_b300_nvfp4_mtp2_r4 / d2_b300_prefill_diag: FlashInfer native FA2-class prefill = 63% of prefill time, 24.3K tok/s, SLO miss at break-even). Which attention kernel does SGLang give the 512-dim layers on SM103? SGLang v0.5.23 accepts only trtllm_mha / triton / fa4 / aiter for Gemma 4 and defaults to trtllm_mha on SM100 (model_overrides/gemma4.py), so: trtllm_mha first (does SGLang's FlashInfer build have the head_dim-512 TRTLLM-GEN context kernel vLLM 0.34 lacked?), then fa4, then triton (labelled). New snapshot with a smaller host (8 vCPU / 64 GiB) than the t3990 vLLM one (16 / 128), so $/h and break-even differ from r4. Gate, profile, prefill probe, 1.0x/1.5x break-even in both columns, 300 s, seed 7. CHECKPOINT: NVIDIA's ModelOpt NVFP4 (nvidia/Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4), not RedHat's compressed-tensors NVFP4: on the PRO 6000, SGLang's compressed-tensors W4A4 NVFP4 scheme crashed in FlashInfer mm_fp4 ('accepts 2d tensors, got [1, 2520, 576]', the vision tower path at warm-up). Same FP4 format, different producer; noted wherever B300 vLLM vs SGLang is compared.

servers.name: sgl_nvfp4_nv
servers.launch: python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path /root/models/nvfp4_modelopt --served-model-name gemma --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --context-length 32768 --mem-fraction-static 0.88 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report --quantization modelopt_fp4 --attention-backend trtllm_mha

fallbacks.why: SGLang accepts fa4 for Gemma 4; FA4 on SM100 may not cover head_dim 512 (vLLM's copy refuses it)
labelled last resort: SGLang's Triton attention
